# One-paragraph overview

`TODO: keep this synced with the abstract. Working draft:` Loss of Y
chromosome (LOY) in cancer removes the H3K4me2/3 demethylase *KDM5D* and the
H3K27me3 demethylase *UTY*, creating a stereotyped chromatin imbalance:
H3K4me3 accumulates at Polycomb-marked loci, PRC2 redistributes off canonical
neural and developmental targets, and silenced developmental programs are
derepressed. The LOY+ state becomes addicted to SAGA/STAGA coactivator
function to maintain this aberrant transcriptional program. Targeting
SAGA/STAGA is selectively lethal in LOY+ cells across our isogenic systems,
in pan-cancer dependency data, and in patient-derived cohorts.
